capabilities: teach Obsidian basics through six guided lessons with an on-screen cat
walk through building an LLM Wiki in an isolated practice folder
bundle prompts for a real AI ingest via the clipboard
track lesson progress with a sidebar map, skip and undo commands
remind users of ingest days and evening notes after graduation
disambiguation: Not an AI plugin; it never calls an AI itself and in trial mode shows pre-written pages, using your own AI app only in the final lesson.
extras: Obsidian staff have not manually reviewed the plugin. Desktop-only (the cat stage does not run on mobile). No network access; real mode works only through the clipboard and the user's own AI app. Available in Korean, English and Simplified Chinese.
motivation: The author saw people wanting "a wiki the AI keeps for you" who "don't know Obsidian, and the tutorials assume a terminal", and built the plugin to bridge that gap.
problem: Beginners who want an AI-maintained wiki don't know Obsidian, and existing tutorials assume terminal knowledge, so there is no guided, in-app way to learn.

relations.evidence: The layout matches the Karpathy LLM Wiki community plugin, so when you outgrow the tutor
The cat renderer and stage come from Vault Pet (MIT) by the same author.

requires.name: Claude desktop app or any chat AI (ChatGPT etc.)

summary: Interactive tutorial where a pixel cat teaches Obsidian basics and walks beginners through building an LLM Wiki inside a practice folder.
